Verified: Chengying Mao, Jifu Chen, Xiaorong Yi and Linlin Wen, “An empirical study on metamorphic testing for recommender systems,” Information and Software Technology 169 (May 2024), 107410, studies six metamorphic relations across LibRec, PREA and Surprise; it supports relational reliability testing, without establishing NextItNet-specific validity. [2024 paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.infsof.2024.107410). Alejandra Duque-Torres, Claus Klammer, Stefan Fischer, Dietmar Pfahl and Rudolf Ramler, “Assessing the strength of Metamorphic Testing applied to optimisation software—Experience from industry,” same journal 186 (October 2025), 107807, studies an industrial optimisation algorithm. Its 405 mutants comprise 236 unchanged on all sampled inputs, 85 changed on every input, and 84 mixed. Sample-relative equivalence does not prove semantic equivalence. [2025 paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.infsof.2025.107807).

For the audit, define an independent oracle as a specification-derived assertion or separately implemented reference, frozen independently of diagnostic tuning. An equivalent mutant preserves specified observable behaviour for every admissible input; an ineffective mutant merely produces no measured change on the exercised inputs. Neither survival nor unchanged HR proves equivalence. Use killed eligible non-equivalent mutants / all eligible non-equivalent mutants; report invalid, equivalent, ineffective and unresolved counts separately, with exclusion criteria fixed beforehand. Held-out operators mean entire fault-generation families withheld during suite development—not new instances of familiar operators. These are audit recommendations; the retrieved papers do not establish this held-out protocol.

NextItNet applications: check readout against an independently computed final nonpadding index; verify prefix features remain unchanged when future tokens change; compare residual blocks against explicit x+F(x) computation. Residual suppression may legitimately leave outputs unchanged when F(x)=0. Freeze tolerances, measure clean-model false alarms, and report detection by operator and input sensitivity. These transfer the papers’ methodological lessons; neither directly validates these three faults.
